scope: Word table parity: cell text is part of the edit model, and Office 365's contextual Table tab edits rows, columns, header repeat, distribution, cell alignment and table alignment

reference.word: Office 365 Word table commands (Insert Above/Below, Insert Left/Right, Delete Row/Column/Table, Header Row, Distribute Columns, cell vertical alignment, table alignment)
reference.gapBefore: web/src/app/office-webapp.component.ts synced only .op-word-p[data-paragraph]; text typed inside a table cell was not written to WordParagraph or w:t, so leaving the page or saving dropped it. WORD_RIBBON had 10 tabs and no table commands.

changes.model: core/office/word-tables.ts: insertTableRow, insertTableColumn, deleteTableRow, deleteTableColumn, deleteWordTable, setTableHeaderRow, distributeTableColumns, setRowVerticalAlign, setTableAlignment, readTableLayout
changes.parse: docx.ts reads w:tblW (pct/dxa) and w:jc into WordBlock.widthPct/align; word-insert.ts stores xmlNode + equal grid for a new table
changes.rowMap: word-paginate.ts: each flow fragment carries rowMap (repeated header rows + the block body row), fragment=true and splitRow only when the row really continues on the next page; the paginator merges fragments by fragment instead of splitRow
changes.cellEditing: office-webapp.component.ts/html: every cell paragraph in a whole row carries data-cell-block/row/col/p and a sourceIndex for sliced paragraphs; focusout writes the text back to the model and w:t; Enter splits a cell paragraph into a new w:p
changes.ui: word-ribbon.ts + word-ribbon.component: contextual 'table' tab with 3 groups/15 commands and Fluent icons (table-stack-*, table-delete-*, table-repeat, table-resize-column, textbox-align-*); table tab appears only while the caret is in a table
changes.safety: A row that is physically split across pages is read-only (contenteditable=false) because its visible text is a slice of a paragraph, not the whole paragraph
changes.render: table width from w:tblW and w:jc alignment (center/right use margin auto) also apply to documents that declare them

probes.uiLoad: headless Edge CDP: sample loaded to 546 pages, 839 distinct rows, 0 console errors
probes.cellEdit: cell 'Số CTKT' changed to 'KIEM TRA BANG'; after focusout and re-render the cell still shows 'KIEM TRA BANG' (before the fix the model kept the old text)
probes.tableTab: tabs after clicking a table cell: Trang chủ, Chèn, Bảng, Vẽ, … ; groups: Hàng & Cột / Bố cục / Căn chỉnh; 15 commands; single-row ribbon renders 15 20px Fluent icons
probes.insertRow: click 'Chèn hàng dưới' → 840 distinct rows in block 396
probes.deepDelete: on a page after 150, clicked a body cell (data-cell-row 235) and 'Xóa hàng' → 839 distinct rows, proving the row map addresses the block row and not a fragment-local row
probes.pageCount: 546 after load and after the sizing pass

verification.uiBuild: npm run office:ui:build — main.js 978.98 kB, styles.css 146.25 kB
verification.i18n: web 3280 keys, all 13 locales 100% (strict parity), mobile 100%
verification.console: 0 exceptions, 0 console errors during load, cell edit, insert row and delete row

remaining: Cells of a row that is split across pages stay read-only: their rendered text is one slice, so writing it back needs a slice-to-paragraph-range map
Merge Cells, Split Cells, Split Table, cell margins and a full Table Properties dialog are not in the contextual tab yet
W-A21 page-level layout is unchanged: total pages match Word (546), per-row page starts still drift (task-514)
